policy.bot_protection_note: www.land.vic.gov.au (the VPSR sales file host) is behind a Cloudflare managed JS challenge, identical in kind to NSW's valuergeneral.nsw.gov.au (Sprint 5). Verified accessible via the same legitimate technique already established in this project: a real (headed) browser session that lets the challenge JS execute and redirect, via gstack /browse --headed. This is NOT a CAPTCHA-solving, stealth-fingerprint-spoofing, or proxy-rotation technique (all of which remain forbidden) — it is the browse tool's standard headed mode, the same mechanism a human's own browser uses, and was already the established solution for an equivalent official-government Cloudflare challenge in this project.

entries.dataset_name: Victorian Property Sales Report (VPSR) — Median House by Suburb Quarterly
entries.publisher: Department of Transport and Planning (Valuer-General Victoria)
entries.download_url_pattern: https://www.land.vic.gov.au/__data/assets/excel_doc/<id>/<file_id>/median-house-q<N>-<YYYY>.xls (exact numeric path segments change per release — always resolve via the CKAN package_show API, never guess)
entries.geography_level: suburb (VG Victoria's own locality grouping — NOT always 1:1 with ASGS SAL, see victoria_geography_mapping_report.json)
entries.available_history: metadata record published 01/08/2014; live catalog currently exposes 9 quarterly resources (Dec 2023 - Dec 2025); each individual file covers only its own quarter's median (not cumulative history like the rental report)
entries.file_format: legacy .xls (OLE2 Compound Document / BIFF binary format, Crystal Reports export) — NOT modern .xlsx (OOXML). This project's existing exceljs dependency cannot read this format; a different parsing approach is required (resolved in Phase 5 build script).
measures: Melbourne metro and country Victoria summary rows
entries.dwelling_type_scope: house only — separate parallel products exist for unit and vacant land (see vic_vpsr_median_unit / vic_vpsr_median_land below); no townhouse/villa-specific breakout, no strata/nature-of-property evidence fields comparable to NSW PSI
entries.access_method: bulk_file_download, requires a real (headed) browser session to pass www.land.vic.gov.au's Cloudflare JS challenge — plain HTTP (curl) and default headless browser navigation both return HTTP 403 / a challenge page
entries.notes: Verified live: HTTP 200 via headed browser, downloaded 233KB genuine OLE2 Compound Document (confirmed via file-signature inspection, not an HTML challenge page). CKAN package_show API (no bot protection) is the reliable way to resolve the current-quarter file's exact download URL each refresh cycle.

entries.dataset_name: Homes Victoria Rental Report — Moving annual rent by suburb
entries.publisher: Homes Victoria (Department of Families, Fairness and Housing)
entries.download_url_pattern: https://www.dffh.vic.gov.au/moving-annual-rent-suburb-<month>-quarter-<YYYY>-excel (resolved per-quarter from the rental-report / past-rental-reports pages)
entries.geography_level: suburb (VG-style locality/town grouping, same mapping challenge as VPSR)
entries.available_history: one file per quarter, but EACH file contains the FULL historical time series back to March 2000 (confirmed live: 233 columns = ~103 quarters x count+median pairs, per dwelling-type/bedroom-count sheet) — only the LATEST quarterly file needs to be downloaded to get complete history, not every historical file
entries.file_format: modern .xlsx — 7 sheets (1/2/3 bedroom flat, 2/3/4 bedroom house, All properties), one row per suburb, one Count+Median column pair per quarter
measures: moving annual median weekly rent by suburb
new bond lodgement count (sample size) by suburb and quarter
entries.dwelling_type_scope: flat (1/2/3 bed) and house (2/3/4 bed) — maps to apartment_unit / detached_house canonically; no townhouse/villa-specific category (documented, not invented)
entries.licence_notes: to be confirmed exactly (Victorian Government content is CC BY 4.0 by default per whole-of-government policy; no dataset-specific licence page found on dffh.vic.gov.au — treated as CC BY 4.0 pending explicit confirmation)
entries.access_method: bulk_file_download, direct — NO bot protection observed (dffh.vic.gov.au is a plain HTTPS government site; the browse tool's normal `download ... --navigate` succeeded on the first attempt)
entries.notes: Missing/small-sample suburb-quarter cells are marked '-' in the source file (confirmed live: e.g. Docklands shows '-','-' for early quarters) — maps directly to NULL, never zero-filled, exactly matching this project's established convention.

entries.dataset_name: Homes Victoria Rental Report — Quarterly median rents by Local Government Area
entries.publisher: Homes Victoria (Department of Families, Fairness and Housing)
entries.notes: Coarser-grain fallback — not needed as the primary source since suburb-level data (vic_moving_annual_rent_by_suburb) is directly available, but retained as the documented LGA-grain fallback per this sprint's Phase 6 rule (never fabricate suburb figures if suburb data becomes unavailable in a future refresh).

entries.dataset_name: ASGS geography backbone, Census dwelling stock/tenure/demographics, ABS Building Approvals — Victoria rows
entries.notes: Confirmed via direct branch query (sprint10_existing_state_audit.json): Victoria (state_code='2') already has 2,944 SAL / 522 SA2 / 80 LGA geography rows, 23,552 dwelling-stock fact rows, 17,664 tenure fact rows, and is already represented in every demographic/dwelling-stock/building-approvals mart with the full expected 2,944 SAL rows. No new download or discovery needed for this source family — see warehouse/adapters/vic/supply/adapter.md.

rejected_or_deferred_sources.candidate: Consumer Affairs Victoria RTBA raw bond lodgement microdata
rejected_or_deferred_sources.reason_not_selected: Homes Victoria's own published Rental Report (moving annual rent by suburb) already provides the same underlying RTBA bond data pre-aggregated to suburb/quarter/dwelling-type with sample counts — using the official published aggregate is preferred over re-deriving the same statistic from a rawer, less-documented microdata source, consistent with using the most authoritative published product rather than re-implementing a government agency's own methodology.

rejected_or_deferred_sources.candidate: REIV (Real Estate Institute of Victoria) median price data
rejected_or_deferred_sources.reason_not_selected: REIV is an industry association, not an official government/statutory authority — excluded per this sprint's 'official government or official statutory authority sources only' rule, and per the standing 'no commercial property portal' rule (REIV data feeds several commercial portals).
